# Sources of `content/local/hisnul-muslim/` (ADR-27)

**No text of the collection is in this repository.** The files live in `content/local/hisnul-muslim/`, which
`.gitignore` excludes, on the machine that fetched them. This record holds only where they came from, when, how many
there are and each file's SHA-256, so any copy can be checked byte for byte. The repository is public: committing the
text would republish it, and nobody has given permission for that.

## What and from where

- **Collection:** Hisnul Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), Bengali, as served by the ThelightHub dua API, book 1
  ("হিসনুল মুসলিম" in its `books.json`: 133 chapters, 312 duas; KNOWN, read in the fetched file).
- **API:** `https://dua-api.hisnul.workers.dev`. Files fetched:
  - `b1-chapters.json` from `https://dua-api.hisnul.workers.dev/api/books/1/chapters`
  - `duas/<id>.json` from `https://dua-api.hisnul.workers.dev/api/duas/<id>`, one per `dua_global_id` listed by the API's
    paged dua list in the same session (312 ids, not contiguous: the highest is 422; the hash lines below name them all).
- **Fetched:** 2026-11-28, about 21:00 +0600 (KNOWN: the files' modification time, `stat`, 21:00). Copied byte for byte into
  `content/local/hisnul-muslim/` on 2026-11-28 21:13 +0600 (`diff -r` and `cmp` against the download: identical).
- **Not kept:** the API's `books.json`, `categories.json` and paged lists, used only to find the ids.

## Who wrote it, and the permission

- **Arabic:** the dua texts of Hisnul Muslim (Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani's compilation, ASSUMED from the title;
  the API names no compiler).
- **Bengali translation, transliteration, notes and references: translator UNKNOWN.** The ThelightHub `dua-api`
  README names no translator, edition or source for the Bengali; it says "MIT" and "public domain" without saying who
  holds the text or on what basis (reported by the session that fetched the data on 2026-11-28; not re-read for this
  record). Neither is a permission from whoever translated it.
  How to find out: compare against printed Bengali editions of Hisnul Muslim (ASSUMED: several exist), or ask the API's author.
- **Founder's decision, 2026-11-28, in chat:** "add hisnul muslim"; "license doesn't matter, I'll talk to the developer
  later". The founder owns the permission question (Q16). Until it is settled the text stays local and out of every
  release (ADR-27).
- **Not reviewed.** No reviewer has read any of it (INV-C1, INV-C6). It is not the reviewed dua kind of ADR-22.

## Counts (KNOWN, counted in the fetched files; checked by `checkHisnulMuslim` and `HisnulRealFilesTest`)

- 312 duas, 133 chapters (`chap_id` 0 to 132), 426 segments.
- Segments with Arabic 414, with a Bengali translation 409, with a transliteration 390, with a reference 315.
- 6 segments have Arabic but no Bengali translation, in 6 duas (the API's `ID` 120, 131, 27.28, 28.19, 58.2, 59.2;
  global ids 227, 248, 384, 385, 417, 418); 5 of those duas have no Bengali at all. 16 duas have no translation in
  any segment; 11 of them are a note and a reference only (no Arabic). 179 dua files have `"chapname": null`; the chapter's name is taken from `b1-chapters.json`.
- One text holds Latin digits (dua 107, chapter 28, its `top` note citing surah numbers); it is shown as the source has it.

count chapters 133
count duas 312
count segments 426

## How to fetch again

`tools/fetch-hisnul-muslim.sh` downloads the 313 files into `content/local/hisnul-muslim/` and checks each against the
lines below. It is never run by the build: the app and the build make no network request (INV-P1). Run it by hand.
